name: FormSection
description: One part of a bigger form (a wide dialog or sheet): a small heading with its status and, when it has a consequence, a helper line, then its fields. Consecutive sections are separated by a hairline.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the heading, only when the section has a consequence its title doesn't say: what is lost, who sees it, how to recover. Not what the section is for: its title says that.

props.name: status
props.description: Where this part stands (Complete, Optional, Off …): a quiet tag.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
